articles.summary: During and after hurricane season each year, we take moments to reflect on the devastation experienced by policyholders and, too often, the loss of lives. We think about how the insurance industry steps up at this time. And later, we have to look at insured loss numbers so that we learn where to improve and adjust. This year, though, we’re doing it in March.
articles.title: The Human Side of Insurance
